evidence: Unique structural attributes of the PSI‐NDH supercomplex in Physcomitrium patens
Plant material and isolation of thylakoid membranes
Cultures of the P. patens subsp. patens (Hedwig) ecotype ‘Gransden, 2004’ were grown in the Knop medium
The 5‐days old (from the last renewal of the continuously grown culture in a ratio 1:3 for culture and new medium, respectively) plant material was harvested by simple filtration in a sieve
we performed a proteomic analysis by mass spectrometry (MS) on the B1, B2 and B3 bands... MS analysis was also performed on the B4 band
